title: The labels config
description: mediators.json in placket's config directory ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/placket, else ~/.config/placket, a variable that is not an absolute path counting as unset): the mediators one user reaches. A label is a local, human name, never signed. Relative paths are taken under the config directory. Entries must not collide: no two have one label, no two of different Accords use one socket, no two use one state directory, and no two of one Accord are both unlabelled; those checks are the client's, not this schema's.

key.description: The party's key file. Its state directory is <key>.state/<the Accord id's hex>/.

founding.description: The founding set's path, from which placket mcp reads the key's roles.

socket.description: The window's socket; absent, the Accord's default socket.

label.description: 1 to 63 of a-z, 0-9 and -, starting with a letter or a digit.
